04 September 2026
IMI plc ("IMI" or the "Company")

Transactions in own shares

LEI: 2138002W9Q21PF751R30

IMI announces that on 03 September 2026 it purchased through Deutsche Bank AG, London Branch (trading for these purposes as Deutsche Numis) ("Deutsche Numis") the following number of its ordinary shares for cancellation at an average price of 3,031.9928 pence per share:

Date of purchase:
03/09/26
Number of ordinary shares purchased:
98,600
Highest purchase price paid per share:
3,056.00
Lowest purchase price paid per share:
3,004.00
Volume weighted average price paid per share:
3,031.9928


Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Company's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 249,615,473 The Company holds 11,648,836 ordinary shares in treasury and therefore the total number of voting rights in the Company will be 237,966,637.
